Apex Radiance: manual install (without Apex Radiance Setup)

Recommended instead: run ApexRadianceSetup.exe from this zip. It finds the game, installs everything below,
checks your other mods, keeps a restore point before every change and updates in one click.

By hand:
1. Close The Sims 3 and its launcher.
2. If The Sims 3\Game\Bin has no ASI loader yet (another .asi mod such as Sims3SettingsSetter already brings one),
   add one, for example Ultimate ASI Loader: https://github.com/ThirteenAG/Ultimate-ASI-Loader/releases
3. Copy ApexRadiance.asi from this folder into The Sims 3\Game\Bin.
4. Optional, DXVK (fewer stutters, the renderer Apex Radiance is tested with): put DXVK's 32-bit d3d9.dll in
   The Sims 3\Game\Bin.
5. Optional, the RTX Remix bridge instead of DXVK (more free memory; needs a Vulkan graphics card): download the
   separate "RTX Remix bridge" file from the Apex Radiance page, move any d3d9.dll in Game\Bin to a backup folder,
   then unzip the bridge into The Sims 3\Game\Bin, keeping its .trex folder.
   EA app version only: in both bridge.conf files (Game\Bin and Game\Bin\.trex), set client.targetProcess = TS3.exe
6. Start the game, load a world and press Ctrl+Shift+F11 to open the Apex Radiance menu.

Update: close the game and replace ApexRadiance.asi (and the bridge files, if you use it) with the new ones.
Your settings stay in Documents\Electronic Arts\The Sims 3\Apex Radiance.
